items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: I played with Man Perez on the roof guard. ... We played in the roof guard for a couple of years.

ctx.x: Was that tennis sax sax? Alto.

Alto sax, yeah. They bought my first sax. And after, and I left them, I left them, and I went playing with Man Perez. You heard of Man Perez? Yes, sir, yeah. Well, I played with Man Perez on the roof guard. Oh, yeah. I played in the roof guard. We played in the roof guard for a couple of years. Many years. Yeah. I played. I left the roof guard and joined Sidney. Sidney was playing on the hall. Sidney Desvene. Sidney was playing on the... On the... Capital? On the Capitol. That's right. Not the Capitol. Yeah.…
Was that mostly on saxophone or clarinet?
